content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CASDIC DRDO Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 11-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CASDIC DRDO Paid Intern posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the CASDIC DRDO Paid Intern recruitment is 11th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Paid Intern position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be pursuing their final year B.E/B.Tech with a minimum CGPA of 7.5, or pursuing their second year M.Sc with at least 70% marks in their first-year exam.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Paid Intern role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 30 vacancies for the Paid Intern position at the Combat Aircraft System Development and Integration Centre (CASDIC DRDO).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Paid Intern position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Paid Intern role will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 5000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Paid Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 25 years. Specific age relaxation details are not provided in the available data.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Paid Intern positions?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on merit determined by previous exam marks, followed by an online interview or interaction.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for the CASDIC DRDO Paid Intern posts?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. In which city is the CASDIC DRDO located?
faq.answer: The Combat Aircraft System Development and Integration Centre (CASDIC DRDO) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560093.

faq.question: Q10. When will the internship start for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The internship is scheduled to commence on 01st December 2026 for the candidates who are successfully selected.
